diagrams.title: From project to Workbench projection
diagrams.summary: Workbench contracts separate project admission, workspace state, execution, and observation.

nodes.label: Project manifest
nodes.description: Required and provided capabilities are declared.

nodes.label: Registries
nodes.description: Compatible tools, widgets, and dialects are resolved.

nodes.label: Workspace
nodes.description: Panels, sessions, and artifacts are coordinated.

nodes.label: Runtime plan
nodes.description: An admitted execution is prepared.

nodes.label: Observation
nodes.description: Checkpoints, diagnostics, and reported effects are captured.

nodes.label: UI projection
nodes.description: Surfaces make state manipulable.

diagrams.caption: Workbench remains usable through its contracts even if its current UI projection disappears.

diagrams.title: Five authority planes that must remain distinct
diagrams.summary: A higher-order composition remains explicit when every state has one authority and an identifiable lifetime.

nodes.label: Executable artifact
nodes.description: Identity, structure, and revision of the subject to realize.

nodes.label: Workspace
nodes.description: Surfaces, layout, modes, and working preferences.

nodes.label: Editable projection
nodes.description: Selection, zoom, positions, and local drafts.

nodes.label: Derived artifact
nodes.description: Reproducible result identified by its sources and configuration.

nodes.label: Runtime session
nodes.description: Current lifecycle, admitted commands, effects, and observations.

diagrams.caption: These planes cooperate but never silently transfer their identity or authority.

diagrams.title: Round trip of a semantic change
diagrams.summary: An editable projection requests a change; only the canonical authority can create the revision later observed by surfaces.

nodes.label: Surface gesture
nodes.description: The user manipulates a projection.

nodes.label: Typed intent
nodes.description: The gesture is translated without mutating the domain.

nodes.label: Command routing
nodes.description: The capability and its authority are resolved.

nodes.label: Canonical commit
nodes.description: The admitted command produces a new revision.

nodes.label: Observable snapshot
nodes.description: The new state is published to readers.

nodes.label: Reprojection
nodes.description: All legitimate surfaces converge on this reading.

diagrams.caption: A resize, zoom, or purely visual move stops in the projection and does not follow this cycle.

diagrams.title: Produce and invalidate a derived artifact
diagrams.summary: Workbench can reuse a result only while every source that determines it still matches.

nodes.label: Versioned sources
nodes.description: Canonical revision, assets, and dependencies are identified.

nodes.label: Configuration
nodes.description: Evaluator, runtime, and relevant conditions complete the key.

nodes.label: Derivation key
nodes.description: The reproducible identity of the computation is built.

nodes.label: Derived result
nodes.description: The computation and its useful observations are preserved.

nodes.label: Reuse or recompute
nodes.description: An equal key allows reading; a changed dependency invalidates its cone.

diagrams.caption: A layout change does not invalidate an independent semantic result.

diagrams.title: Refresh, reconnection, and idempotent recovery
diagrams.summary: Recovery distinguishes persisted configuration, reread authority, and compatible session to avoid duplicate commands and revisions.

nodes.label: Persisted configuration
nodes.description: Layout, preferences, and references are restored.

nodes.label: Reread authorities
nodes.description: External and canonical states are checked before display.

nodes.label: Resolve the session
nodes.description: A compatible session is resumed or a new one is explicitly created.

nodes.label: Reconcile
nodes.description: Cached, stale, unknown, ready, and failed remain distinct.

nodes.label: Publish the reading
nodes.description: The projection receives a coherent snapshot without duplication.

diagrams.caption: A repeated equivalent observation creates no new session, command, or revision.
